standard_prerequisites.name: UR-finiteness of the pair
standard_prerequisites.use: The fibres of |U| -> |X| and |R| -> |X| over x' are finite.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale images are open
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemma etale-image-open (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows replacing X by the image of |U| -> |X|.

standard_prerequisites.name: Presentation topology
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemmas points-presentation and topology-points (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the R-invariant closed set with the inverse image of a closed subset of |X|.

standard_prerequisites.name: Generalizations lift along etale morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Used twice, along s and along t.

standard_prerequisites.name: Points over fibre products
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemma points-cartesian (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the final point r with s(r) = u, t(r) = u_1.

core_obligations: Reduce to U affine and U -> X surjective etale.
Finiteness over x' gives the closed sets T (closure of the u'_i in |U|) and T' (closure of the r'_j in |R|).
Show T = s(T') = t(T') is R-invariant using that generalizations lift along s; conclude T is the inverse image of the closed T'' = closure of x', so T contains a point u_1 over x.
Finish: choose r with s(r) = u, t(r) = u_1; lift the generalization u'_i -> u_1 along t to r' -> r and set u' = s(r').
proof_roadmap: Reduction; closed-set construction; R-invariance and descent to |X|; second lifting step.
difficulty_reason: The R-invariance argument with the two generalization-lifting steps is the substance.
